messages:
sophia: Quick thread — finalizing speaker rotations and fallback matrix for the Jun 18 webinar. Need to lock timeslots and who covers demos.
devin: Can we confirm panelist arrival windows? timezone juggling was messy last time.
aisha: For APAC-friendly slot we said 11:30 PT / 19:30 CET, speakers: Priya + Marco, backup: Devin if Priya gets delayed.
marco: I can cover demos but prefer to avoid the heavy live-run for the quantization segment — use recorded snippet instead.
sophia: Good call. Plan: live demo for routing & latency, recorded deep-dive for quantization + Q&A.
priya: I may have a calendar conflict — holding until 2pm PT, will confirm by EOD. If I drop, Devin steps in for my slot.
devin: Ack. I'll prep an abbreviated demo deck (5 min) and a 2-slide fallback explainer for ops in case of hot swap.
ops-bot: Reminder: rehearsal window booked Thu 9am PT and Fri 4pm PT. RSVP required.
aisha: Who's on MC duties for transitions? We need someone to handle panel handoffs and audience q's.
sophia: I'll MC. Devin, you're our live demo owner. Marco, you cue recorded segment. Aisha runs the Q&A queue.
marco: I'll check audio levels on the recorded clip and export two bitrates in case of network trouble.
priya: If I join late, can I drop into the panel remotely without slides? I can speak to use-cases live.
devin: Yes — we have a mid-panel anchor where slides aren't required. Ops, can we ensure cohost permissions for quick ad-hoc screen share?
ops-bot: Confirmed: cohost toggles ready. Pre-uploaded backup video link: drive.redwood/demo-quant.mp4 (ops only).
aisha: Routing rules for inbound signups during the webinar? We want to tag leads by interest: "Dedicated", "Private", "Hosted".
sophia: Marketing will send a short poll via Slido at 5:10 PT to capture intent. Tagging rules: yes, pit into CRM with UTM + poll response.
devin: Also add a quick benchmark snippet in chat (latency/cost bullet) linking to the benchmark page so attendees can click during Q's.
marco: Run-of-show checklist draft: 1) 0:00 intro 2) 5:00 roadmap + benchmarks 3) 15:00 live demo routing 4) 25:00 recorded quant deep-dive 5) 35:00 panel Q&A 6) 50:00 CTA + polls 7) wrap.
sophia: Perfect — can everyone confirm they can attend Thu 9am rehearsal? If not, specify blackout windows.
priya: I can do Thu 9am but might be 5 min late.
devin: In. I'll run the demo handshake script at the top of rehearsal so ops can validate tokens and model endpoints.
aisha: Ops, can you simulate a fallback: model variant unavailable -> auto-route to hosted LLM v2? Want to test latency impact.
ops-bot: Test scenario scheduled Fri 4pm rehearsal: simulated endpoint failure -> auto-failover to hosted-v2. Latency logging enabled.
sophia: Great. Last piece: public-facing abstract and speaker blurbs — marketing to freeze by Wed noon so we can push signups. Devin, can you draft a 1-paragraph bio for yourself?
devin: On it. Will drop a draft in #marketing-assets by 11:30 PT.
sophia: Thanks team. I'll update the fallback matrix doc and post link in this thread. Please respond with any hard stop constraints. :thumbsup:
